deepseek_columns.ai_commands: sshpass -p "$DUT_PASS" ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no $DUT_USER@$DUT_IP "sudo dmidecode -t 15 2>/dev/null | grep -iA1 \"Log Status\""
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return FULL raw `dmidecode -t 15` output filtered to the `Log Status` value for that section (raw text, verbatim) so the user can diff against expected; judge correctness/persistence after reboot.

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES; extracts decoded status text without raw bitmask, reserved-bit evidence or state-transition context.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; adds actual-log correlation/no-mutation safeguards but lowers capability for pending policy inputs.

original_test_intent: Verify the Type 15 Log Status raw bitfield accurately represents validity and fullness under the current event-log state, has no unapproved reserved bits, remains semantically correct after reboot and is not forced to a desired value by clearing the log.
original_method: Capture raw/decoded status with complete Type 15 layout/access/change-token context and an approved read-only log snapshot, evaluate defined/reserved bits and permitted pre/post state transitions, then repeat after reboot without log mutation.
manual_activity: A user approves the status/transition policy and reboot plan. The agent must not clear or rotate logs to obtain an expected status.
required_inputs: Applicable SMBIOS Log Status bit definitions
Allowed Valid/Full states for the current platform
Policy for reserved bits and multiple Type 15 records
Expected relationship to Change Token and approved read-only log utilization metadata
Approved reboot/OOB recovery and legitimate state-transition rules
safety_requirements: Do not clear, rotate, write or inject log records; snapshot existing evidence before and after reboot.
Preserve the raw status byte because decoded text may omit reserved bits or collapse multiple flags.
Do not require byte-for-byte status equality across reboot when legitimate events can change fullness/change token; evaluate an approved transition model.
Do not equate Type 15 status with BMC SEL state without explicit mapping.
Stop on invalid status, reserved bits, unexplained transition/correlation mismatch or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Decode raw status bits, correlate them with approved read-only utilization/change-token evidence and evaluate allowed pre/post-reboot transitions.
Do not mutate logs or issue PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve valid/full/reserved-bit and legitimate transition/correlation rules.
Approve reboot/recovery, adjudicate unexpected full/invalid conditions and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The label is relevant, but the fragment omits raw/reserved bits, log identity and whether a pre/post change is legitimate due to newly recorded events.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive complete raw/decoded Type 15 data and read-only log metadata, report every status bit and compare pre/post state under an approved transition model with Change Token context.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Log Status scope, Type 15 script and 5/5-minute values are retained; generic log clearing is excluded.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Decode the raw status bitfield and reserved positions, correlate with read-only log utilization and change token, and evaluate semantic correctness across reboot rather than demanding unchanged bytes.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS Type 15 System Event Log implementations.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS/BMC, log implementation and parser/dmidecode versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 15 Log Status bit semantics, approved platform log-state policy and installed tool documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds raw/reserved-bit evidence and state-transition semantics while removing unsafe log clearing.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Increases coverage for masked bits and legitimate versus anomalous state changes without reducing the original correctness check.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A full/valid indication is metadata and may not independently prove all records are readable or retained.

project_override_considerations: A project may accept a post-reboot status change caused by documented event growth, but must retain pre/post raw status, token and log evidence; it cannot clear the log and then claim persistence.
expected_evidence: Approved Type 15 status bit/reserved/transition policy and platform log mapping
Complete pre-reboot Type 15 record with raw/decoded status, token, layout/access fields and read-only log snapshot
Approved reboot/health plus post-reboot transition analysis without clearing/rotation

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source asks for continued correctness, not necessarily unchanged dynamic status; generic clear-logs preparation is safely excluded without changing intent.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Raw status and transition evidence are safely automatable once policy is supplied.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds raw/reserved bits, dynamic transition semantics and no-clear evidence preservation.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains log correlation/safety while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE classification.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates expected dynamic state, approved reboot and engineer verdict from capability.

review_improvement: Avoids both a false pass caused by clearing the log and a false failure caused by legitimate reboot-generated events changing status.
independent_technical_reasoning: Status is a readable bitfield whose semantic state and correlation can be evaluated automatically without altering the event log.
